title: Annoying features, overall okay
body: Specific tasks require 250 drag and clicks daily. There needs to be a feature with which I can in a second record 90/300 needed times. Currently I can only go 1 by 1 until I reach 90 which takes around 2 minutes, or it gives me an option for half, 150 which is not what I need. Also, the limit for each task cannot be a maximum of 999, and I have to scroll all the way down until I can select 999, instead of there being a input field…

title: I don't recommend this app
body:
It's very hard to use this app because the Premium screen is popping out constantly. The app is not very intuitive to use. 
I don't see the benefit of paying for Premium if I haven't seen value in the free option. Also I couldn't find the option for retroactive input in case you forget to check in the days before. I don't like the options for setting the habits, you have to go through several screen to finish what should be easier task and why only four habits for free use? It look very beautiful and I believe it has a lot of potential.
